dependencyCandidates.name: Poppler text/html utilities (pdftotext, pdftohtml)
dependencyCandidates.qualityGain: High for text PDFs; low for scanned PDFs unless OCR is selected.
dependencyCandidates.portableImpact: Low if utilities are already in the Windows Poppler bundle; otherwise low/medium to include additional Poppler executables.
dependencyCandidates.security: Untrusted PDF parser; run with timeouts, temp isolation and output validation.
dependencyCandidates.rationale: Same toolchain family as existing Poppler/pdftoppm; best immediate PDF text extraction path.

dependencyCandidates.name: pdf2docx
dependencyCandidates.qualityGain: Medium for text/layout PDFs; weak for scanned PDFs without OCR.
dependencyCandidates.license: MIT per current upstream notice; project status says no longer actively maintained.
dependencyCandidates.portableImpact: Medium: Python runtime/library packaging, transitive dependencies and Windows smoke needed.
dependencyCandidates.security: PDF parser surface plus Python dependency supply chain; strict sandbox/temp cleanup required.
dependencyCandidates.rationale: Most direct permissive candidate for PDF->DOCX, but maintenance status blocks immediate adoption.

dependencyCandidates.name: OCRmyPDF
coverageGain: better OCR route for PDF->TXT/DOCX pipelines
dependencyCandidates.qualityGain: High for OCR preprocessing, not an editable DOCX converter by itself.
dependencyCandidates.portableImpact: High: Python, Ghostscript/Tesseract dependencies and Windows packaging complexity.
dependencyCandidates.security: Untrusted PDF/image pipeline; high need for resource limits and temp isolation.
dependencyCandidates.rationale: Strong scanned-PDF foundation, but should follow text-PDF extraction work.

dependencyCandidates.name: MarkItDown
dependencyCandidates.qualityGain: Medium; optimized for Markdown extraction/RAG rather than layout-preserving conversion.
dependencyCandidates.license: Open-source project; exact version/license must be locked before adoption.
dependencyCandidates.portableImpact: Medium: Python packaging and optional plugin decisions.
dependencyCandidates.security: Avoid network/LLM plugins by default; local-only mode required.
dependencyCandidates.rationale: Promising Markdown coverage boost if kept local and dependency footprint is acceptable.

dependencyCandidates.name: MuPDF / PyMuPDF
dependencyCandidates.classification: NEW NATIVE BINARY / NEW PYTHON LIBRARY
dependencyCandidates.security: Untrusted PDF parser; strong isolation required.
dependencyCandidates.rationale: Licensing risk is too high for default Desktop bundling unless Anclora chooses a commercial license.

dependencyCandidates.name: wkhtmltopdf / wkhtmltoimage
dependencyCandidates.license: LGPLv3, but project warns about stale WebKit/untrusted HTML risk.
dependencyCandidates.security: Project warns not to use with untrusted HTML.
dependencyCandidates.rationale: Security/maintenance profile is a bad fit for user-supplied files.

gap.recommendation: INVESTIGATE after Tier 1 blockers with clearer user value.
